title: Thai Tofu Tagine
description: A spicy and flavorful Thai-inspired dish made with tofu, vegetables, and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over steamed rice or noodles.
Optional: serve with sliced fresh chilies and lime wedges on the side.
